outcome: macroscopic placental features (volume, area, thickness, diameter, circumference, number of cotyledons, cord length, shape, cord insertion, infarction, calcification)
microscopic placental features (syncytial knots, villous stromal fibrosis, fibrinoid necrosis, basement membrane thickening of the villi)
cohort: Mothers visiting the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology of IIMSAR & Dr B C Roy Hospital, Haldia, comprising 30 with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and 30 with uncomplicated pregnancies.
finding: The study found that placentas from mothers with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy exhibited significantly decreased weight, volume, and other dimensions, along with distinct macroscopic and microscopic pathological changes indicative of placental dysfunction, compared to placentas from uncomplicated pregnancies.
